core.name: Leader
core.description: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. core.description: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. core.name: Leader
core.description: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks. Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. stratagems.type: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The combined talents of these Death Guard champions drive their followers into a foam-jawed fury, be it through injection with a curdled cocktail of stimms or immersion in a fug of infectious agents.

stratagems.name: DEATH’S HEADS
stratagems.legend: It takes much effort and sacrifice to fashion the disgusting explosives known as death's heads, but the results are spectacularly horrible.

stratagems.name: GRIM REAPERS
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Swollen with bitter arrogance, these warriors carve a path through their perceived lessers and leave them as worm food.

stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Guided in by rasping jets of fumes sent up by this Lord of Virulence, plague-ridden artillery fire and airbursting spore-shells saturate the target zone.

stratagems.name: BLOOMING PESTILENCE
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Death Guard warriors know to chant the sevenfold prayers to unleash Nurgle's bounty on the foe.

stratagems.name: MORTARION'S TEACHINGS
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Exemplifying the Daemon Primarch's doctrines on versatile heavy infantry tactics, these warriors position themselves and let fly.

stratagems.name: UNDYING SPITE
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Driven by bitterness and the putrid vitality of Nurgle's gifts, these warriors fight on for several moments, even after death.

stratagems.name: SICKENING IMPACT
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Employing their crushing bulk and contagious gifts, these Terminators slam into their victims and grind them into putrefying mulch.

stratagems.name: INFESTATION
stratagems.legend: The taint left by the servants of Nurgle is not easily scoured from the stuff of realspace.

stratagems.name: VERMIN CLOUD
stratagems.legend: The storm of insectile contagion sweeps forward, dragging the Death Guard in its wake. None will escape the Plague God’s embrace.

stratagems.name: MYPHITIC INVIGORATION
stratagems.legend: Daemon flies are drawn to and invigorated by the foul miasmas surrounding Myphitic Blight‑haulers. In the vicinity of these malodorous constructs, the swarms gather in densities great enough to form a living barrier to the foe’s attacks.

stratagems.name: DRONING HORROR
stratagems.legend: Clouds of droning daemon flies sweep across the battlefield to envelop the enemies of the Death Guard. As their victims claw and scratch at the seething swarms, Mortarion’s sons pick off their targets at leisure.

stratagems.name: EYE OF THE SWARM
stratagems.legend: The vermin swarms intensify as the Death Guard close in upon the enemy. As their foes clutch and tear their crawling skin, pitiless Plague Marines unleash volleys of point‑blank fire into their tormented foes.

stratagems.name: NAUSEATING PAROXYSMS
stratagems.legend: The contagion borne by the Death Guard and their attendant swarms of winged vermin triggers bouts of sickness and convulsion in those they encounter.

stratagems.name: ENERVATING ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.legend: Swathed in a buzzing cloak of pathogenic decay, Nurgle’s chosen crash into the foe, disease dealing death as surely as fist, maul and blade.

stratagems.name: DRAWN TO DESPAIR
stratagems.legend: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: STINKING MIRE
stratagems.legend: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.

stratagems.name: BLIGHTED LAND
stratagems.legend: Firing diseased submunitions or belching swarms of daemonic parasites from its hull, this war engine befouls the battlefield as it advances.

stratagems.effect: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS GRIND
stratagems.legend: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: FONT OF FILTH
stratagems.legend: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle's weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: EYESTINGER STORM
stratagems.legend: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.

Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.name: GNAWING HUNGER
stratagems.legend: Gripped by a sudden, monstrous hunger, the Poxwalkers surge forward in a ravenous mass.

stratagems.name: SHOCK AND HORROR
stratagems.legend: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.

stratagems.name: SHAMBLING WALL
stratagems.legend: Lacking even basic self-preservation instincts, Poxwalkers make excellent walking shields.

stratagems.name: GRIP OF THE WALKING POX
stratagems.legend: Those infected by walking pox may fall as though fatally wounded, but they soon rise again.

If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.

stratagems.name: SMEARED WITH FILTH
stratagems.legend: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.

stratagems.name: HIDDEN AMONGST THE DEAD
stratagems.legend: Another wave of Poxwalkers rises from the battlefield’s carrion heaps.

stratagems.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

stratagems.name: CLUTCHING CORRUPTION
stratagems.legend: The daemons of Nurgle grasp their victims tightly with rotting talons and coiling tentacles, their clutch as inescapable as entropy itself.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: ALL IS ROT
stratagems.legend: Death Guard warriors open fire into foes already embattled by Nurgle’s daemons, knowing that no matter who they hit, all will wither and rot.

Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

stratagems.name: MIRESLICK
stratagems.legend: Beneath the tread of Nurgle’s daemons, even ferrocrete or plasteel soon turns to a quagmire of rotting matter, in which their unlucky enemies begin to sink and become trapped.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.

stratagems.name: AVATARS OF DECAY
stratagems.legend: Countless diseases blossom in the unreal flesh of Nurgle's daemon childer, manifestations of his blessings to be spread to all.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase.TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

stratagems.name: FLESHY AVALANCHE
stratagems.legend: The ephemeral structures of realspace have no power to halt the onset of Nurgle's Great Unclean Ones; they crumble, rot and burst apart before their unholy bulk.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.TARGET: One PLAGUE LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.target: One PLAGUE LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: PERSISTENT PESTS
stratagems.legend: There is no simple way to wholly cleanse a Nurgling infestation once it has taken root.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Any phase.TARGET: One NURGLINGS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.

stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: POX FLARE
stratagems.legend: Like fever heat bursting into unclean flame, the diseases infesting these Poxwalkers flare with sudden infectious vitality.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Fight phase.TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: SHAMBLING ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.legend: Relentless, untiring, the plague-rotted hordes press forward in a tide of grasping hands, stinking bodies and gnashing, splintered teeth.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.EFFECT: After that enemy unit ends that Fall Back move, if your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, your unit can make a Normal move.

stratagems.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: After that enemy unit ends that Fall Back move, if your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, your unit can make a Normal move.

stratagems.name: PATH OF PESTILENCE
stratagems.legend: Long have lurking cultists planned the uprising and prepared the route for their plague-blessed masters to process to victory.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Movement phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CULTISTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 1” of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD CULTISTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 1” of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.

stratagems.name: CHINKS IN THE ARMOUR
stratagems.type: Vectors of Decay – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even the slightest weakness is enough for the foulness of the Death Guard to find a way in.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

stratagems.name: THE DEAD RISE
stratagems.type: Vectors of Decay – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: What appeared moments before to be a mere carrion heap suddenly lurches into foul and grinning unlife.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.TARGET: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Reserves.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Deep Strike ability.RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.target: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Deep Strike ability.RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.

stratagems.name: SEEPING CORROSION
stratagems.type: Vectors of Decay – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Crawling tendrils of foulness spread through the voidship at the touch of the Death Guard, poisoning and rotting luckless foes.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) attempts to open a Hatchway.TARGET: That DEATH GUARD unit.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 1" of your unit and on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit, and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds. Until the end of the phase, if an enemy unit attempts to prevent that Hatchway from being opened, when rolling off, you can re-roll your result.

stratagems.target: That DEATH GUARD unit.

Until the end of the phase, if an enemy unit attempts to prevent that Hatchway from being opened, when rolling off, you can re-roll your result.

stratagems.name: GROTESQUE DEMISE
stratagems.type: Vectors of Decay – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Many of the plague weapons and revolting diseases unleashed by the Death Guard inflict endings so hideous that the mere sight of them is enough to send unharmed enemies fleeing in horror.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) has shot or fought.TARGET: That DEATH GUARD unit.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit that had one or more models destroyed as a result of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: That DEATH GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that had one or more models destroyed as a result of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: DISGUSTINGLY RESILIENT
stratagems.legend: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: PLAGUESURGE
stratagems.legend: The foul miasma around the Death Guard swells and thickens, boiling outward like putrid smog.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Command phase.TARGET: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
stratagems.target: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.

stratagems.name: LEECHSPORE ERUPTION
stratagems.legend: Billowing from this warrior's wounds come clouds of parasitic spores that settle on the foe and drain their vitality, stealing it for the one who spawned them.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Command phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).

stratagems.name: PUTRID DETONATION
stratagems.legend: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Any phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.EFFECT: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

stratagems.name: OVERWHELMING GENEROSITY
stratagems.legend: Unholy filth gushes from Nurgle's faithful into their guns until the armaments threaten to burst like bloated corpses.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.

stratagems.name: CREEPING BLIGHT
stratagems.legend: Those in the grip of Nurgle's unholy plagues become weaker by the moment, barely able to lift their weapons, let alone defend themselves from the attacking Death Guard.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: CLOUD OF FLIES
stratagems.legend: Plague flies engulf these warriors in a storm of buzzing wings and pustulent bodies, soaking up incoming enemy fire and obscuring the Death Guard elite from the foe.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: CORROSIVE CURSE
stratagems.legend: Mere proximity to these repulsive plague champions is enough to see vital systems rust and crumble as the taint of Chaos consumes them.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.EFFECT: Select one objective marker within Contagion Range of and visible to your unit. That objective marker is Secured by your army.RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once and, until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to shoot or declare a charge.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker within Contagion Range of and visible to your unit. That objective marker is Secured by your army.RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once and, until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to shoot or declare a charge.

stratagems.name: ALLIES OF ENTROPY
stratagems.legend: The foul vitality that flows through these warriors is slow to depart, even in extremis.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: SEED OF CORRUPTION
stratagems.legend: Like infectious spores contaminating their victim, the warriors of the Death Guard teleport into battle then dig in as their foulness slowly spreads around them.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.EFFECT: If your unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, it can perform a Tactical Manoeuvre this phase as if it was not set up on the battlefield this turn.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, it can perform a Tactical Manoeuvre this phase as if it was not set up on the battlefield this turn.

abilities.name: Inescapable Corruption
abilities.legend: The combined plague blessings of so many champions of the Plague God is universally contagious, a dreadful omnirot that infests flesh, metal and even the minds and souls of its victims.
abilities.rawDescription: Each time an enemy unit is selected to perform a Tactical Manoeuvre, if that unit is within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that Tactical Manoeuvre has no effect (that enemy unit is still eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn as normal).In addition, in your Command phase, roll one D6 for each objective marker that is within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army and is Secured by your opponent’s army: on a 5+, that objective marker is no longer Secured by your opponent’s army.
abilities.formattedDescription: Each time an enemy unit is selected to perform a Tactical Manoeuvre, if that unit is within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that Tactical Manoeuvre has no effect (that enemy unit is still eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn as normal).In addition, in your Command phase, roll one D6 for each objective marker that is within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army and is Secured by your opponent’s army: on a 5+, that objective marker is no longer Secured by your opponent’s army.

enhancements.name: Miasmic Odour
enhancements.legend: An omnipresent reek of decay wreathes this dark champion, mingling with swarms of parasitic plague flies and turgid clouds of infectious spores.
enhancements.rawDescription: Add 3" to the Contagion Range of the bearer.
enhancements.formattedDescription: Add 3" to the Contagion Range of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Disgusting Reinvigoration
enhancements.legend: Grotesque maws and stabbing probosces burst from this champion’s bloated form to consume and corrupt the very life essence of their victims.
enhancements.rawDescription: Each time the bearer destroys an enemy model with a melee attack, roll one D6: on a 5+, the bearer regains one lost wound (to a maximum of two lost wounds per phase).
enhancements.formattedDescription: Each time the bearer destroys an enemy model with a melee attack, roll one D6: on a 5+, the bearer regains one lost wound (to a maximum of two lost wounds per phase).

stratagems.name: BLESSINGS OF FILTH
stratagems.type: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Employing their unique gifts, this champion enhances the weapons of their comrades with even greater levels of infectious malevolence.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: MALIGNANCE MAGNIFIED
stratagems.type: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The vile talents of such plague specialists act like a filth-smeared lens, focusing and intensifying the infectious gifts of Nurgle.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: GROTESQUE FORTITUDE
stratagems.type: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: After their champion calls down the blessings of Nurgle, these warriors can fight on no matter the catastrophic, often gruesome, damage done to them by the foe.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: RABID INFUSION
stratagems.type: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The combined talents of these Death Guard champions drive their followers into a foam-jawed fury, be it through injection with a curdled cocktail of stimms or immersion in a fug of infectious agents.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: MOBILE VECTOR
stratagems.type: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Nurgle's champions move through the Death Guard ranks like squirming parasites.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army that is not leading a unit.EFFECT: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.

Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.

stratagems.name: DEATH’S HEADS
stratagems.legend: It takes much effort and sacrifice to fashion the disgusting explosives known as death's heads, but the results are spectacularly horrible.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase.TARGET: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).
stratagems.target: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

abilities.name: Manifold Maladies
abilities.legend: A spirit of competition infects Nurgle’s champions when they fight alongside one another. With each vying to outdo the others in virulence, the foes are subjected to a riotous string of nightmarish outbreaks amongst their ranks.
abilities.rawDescription: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle’s Gift. Until the end of the battle, that is your chosen Plague instead of any previously chosen Plague.
abilities.formattedDescription: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle’s Gift. Until the end of the battle, that is your chosen Plague instead of any previously chosen Plague.

enhancements.name: Final Ingredient
enhancements.legend: Be it the eye of a Kroot or a Space Marine’s hearts, ground Ork tusk, or something unnameable wrenched from within a Tyranid’s corpse, this champion needs just one more ingredient to perfect a powerful new plague.
enhancements.rawDescription: BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER only. Once per battle, after the bearers unit has fought, if one or more CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.
enhancements.formattedDescription: BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER only. Once per battle, after the bearers unit has fought, if one or more CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.

enhancements.name: Visions of Virulence
enhancements.legend: The touch of this sorcerer’s mind upon another triggers feverish visions of abundant foulness that erupt into physical manifestations as they reach their crescendo.
enhancements.rawDescription: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer’s Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.
enhancements.formattedDescription: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer’s Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.

enhancements.name: Needle of Nurgle
enhancements.legend: This plague-saturated narthecium delivers generous doses of infernal maladies that restore life to even the most hideously mangled of Mortarion’s sons.
enhancements.rawDescription: PLAGUE SURGEON only. Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer’s unit (instead of 1).
enhancements.formattedDescription: PLAGUE SURGEON only. Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer’s unit (instead of 1).

enhancements.name: Cornucophagus
enhancements.legend: A plague bellows fashioned by daemonic smiths in a realm of pure putrescence, this rasping device exhales an endless cloying soup of lividly glowing plague motes.
enhancements.rawDescription: LORD OF POXES only. In the Declare Battle Formations step select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.

stratagems.name: GRIM REAPERS
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Swollen with bitter arrogance, these warriors carve a path through their perceived lessers and leave them as worm food.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Fight phase.TARGET: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: SIGNAL POX
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Guided in by rasping jets of fumes sent up by this Lord of Virulence, plague-ridden artillery fire and airbursting spore-shells saturate the target zone.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Command phase.TARGET: One LORD OF VIRULENCE model from your army.EFFECT: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. stratagems.name: BLOOMING PESTILENCE
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Death Guard warriors know to chant the sevenfold prayers to unleash Nurgle's bounty on the foe.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Start of any phase.TARGET: One TERMINATOR unit from your army.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.
stratagems.target: One TERMINATOR unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: MORTARION'S TEACHINGS
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Exemplifying the Daemon Primarch's doctrines on versatile heavy infantry tactics, these warriors position themselves and let fly.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase.TARGET: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.
stratagems.target: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.

stratagems.name: UNDYING SPITE
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Driven by bitterness and the putrid vitality of Nurgle's gifts, these warriors fight on for several moments, even after death.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.TARGET: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: SICKENING IMPACT
stratagems.type: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Employing their crushing bulk and contagious gifts, these Terminators slam into their victims and grind them into putrefying mulch.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.TARGET: That TERMINATOR unit.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

abilities.name: Deadly Vectors
abilities.legend: The plagues and parasites to which these elite warriors play host are amongst the most lethal in the galaxy. Moment by moment, even the most resilient foes sicken and wither in their presence until all that remains is rotted matter deliquescing sloppily from mouldering bones.
abilities.rawDescription: In your opponent’s Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit, subtracting 1 from the result if that unit is Below Half-strength. If the result is 6 or less, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Face of Death
enhancements.legend: So grotesque and monstrous is this champion’s aspect that it fills the enemy with unreasoning dread simply to look upon him.
enhancements.rawDescription: TERMINATOR model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.
enhancements.formattedDescription: TERMINATOR model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Vile Vigour
enhancements.legend: A fanatical worshipper of Nurgle and a talented orator, this champion can infect their followers with the urgent need to forge into battle and spread the Plague God’s blessings to all.
enhancements.rawDescription: TERMINATOR model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1" to the Movement characteristic of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.
enhancements.formattedDescription: TERMINATOR model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1" to the Movement characteristic of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Warprot Talisman
enhancements.legend: By invoking the power of this ancient talisman, the bearer can rot a sagging rent in reality and step through the Warp to burst forth elsewhere amidst a gushing sluice of foul fluids.
enhancements.rawDescription: TERMINATOR model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
enhancements.formattedDescription: TERMINATOR model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Helm of the Fly King
enhancements.legend: This armoured helm was crafted by the Daemon Prince Vermifulgus the Pestilent and carries his squirming enchantments. It manifests its wearer's will as roaring swarms of plump flies that whirl about their creator like an occluding shroud or descend on the foe to blind eyes, clog sensors and spread revolted panic.
enhancements.rawDescription: TERMINATOR model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".
enhancements.formattedDescription: TERMINATOR model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.name: INFESTATION
stratagems.legend: The taint left by the servants of Nurgle is not easily scoured from the stuff of realspace.

stratagems.name: CHINKS IN THE ARMOUR
stratagems.type: Vectors of Decay – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even the slightest weakness is enough for the foulness of the Death Guard to find a way in.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

stratagems.name: SEEPING CORROSION
stratagems.type: Vectors of Decay – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Crawling tendrils of foulness spread through the voidship at the touch of the Death Guard, poisoning and rotting luckless foes.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) attempts to open a Hatchway.TARGET: That DEATH GUARD unit.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 1" of your unit and on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit, and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds. Until the end of the phase, if an enemy unit attempts to prevent that Hatchway from being opened, when rolling off, you can re-roll your result.

stratagems.name: GROTESQUE DEMISE
stratagems.type: Vectors of Decay – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Many of the plague weapons and revolting diseases unleashed by the Death Guard inflict endings so hideous that the mere sight of them is enough to send unharmed enemies fleeing in horror.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXWALKERS units) has shot or fought.TARGET: That DEATH GUARD unit.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit that had one or more models destroyed as a result of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Sevenfold Offerings
abilities.legend: Seven by seven the enemy fall, reaped like blighted crops or rotted from within. Seven by seven their souls are offered up to the Lord of Pestilence.
abilities.rawDescription: For every seven enemy models that have been destroyed, add 2" to the Contagion Range of units from your army. Note that any increase to the Contagion Range of units from your army as a result of this rule does not take place while a unit from your army is attacking. In such an event, the increase will take effect after such a unit has finished making its attacks.

enhancements.name: Foul Constitution
enhancements.legend: Rancid with might, feverish with unclean power, this warrior’s diseased body is as unnaturally resilient as it is unfeeling of pain.
enhancements.rawDescription: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
enhancements.formattedDescription: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: Fountaining Filth
enhancements.legend: Bloated fit to burst with noxious corruption, this champion’s straining body is like an overfilled pressure vessel ready to explode like a diseased warhead.
enhancements.rawDescription: When the bearer is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer and roll one D6: on a 2-3, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: VERMIN CLOUD
stratagems.legend: The storm of insectile contagion sweeps forward, dragging the Death Guard in its wake. None will escape the Plague God’s embrace.

stratagems.name: MYPHITIC INVIGORATION
stratagems.legend: Daemon flies are drawn to and invigorated by the foul miasmas surrounding Myphitic Blight‑haulers. In the vicinity of these malodorous constructs, the swarms gather in densities great enough to form a living barrier to the foe’s attacks.

stratagems.name: DRONING HORROR
stratagems.legend: Clouds of droning daemon flies sweep across the battlefield to envelop the enemies of the Death Guard. As their victims claw and scratch at the seething swarms, Mortarion’s sons pick off their targets at leisure.

stratagems.name: EYE OF THE SWARM
stratagems.legend: The vermin swarms intensify as the Death Guard close in upon the enemy. As their foes clutch and tear their crawling skin, pitiless Plague Marines unleash volleys of point‑blank fire into their tormented foes.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding Blast weapons) have the [PISTOL] ability.

stratagems.name: NAUSEATING PAROXYSMS
stratagems.legend: The contagion borne by the Death Guard and their attendant swarms of winged vermin triggers bouts of sickness and convulsion in those they encounter.

stratagems.legend: Swathed in a buzzing cloak of pathogenic decay, Nurgle’s chosen crash into the foe, disease dealing death as surely as fist, maul and blade.

abilities.name: Verminous Haze
abilities.legend: A cloud of winged insects descends over Mortarion’s pathogenic sons, obscuring their malodorous ranks and shielding them from the eyes and augurs of the enemy. Beneath thrumming storms of fat-bodied flies, Plague Marines stride towards their wavering foes until they are close enough to unleash punishing volleys of killing fire.

enhancements.name: Droning Chorus
enhancements.legend: Festering swarms follow this champion to battle, and the drone of a billion flies invigorates his warriors’ rotting bodies, lending them fresh focus.

enhancements.name: Insectile Murmuration
enhancements.legend: The buzzing swarms respond to this champion’s will, sweeping down upon his chosen target, their crawling, biting and droning enfeebling the horrified foe.
enhancements.rawDescription: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is within Contagion Range of one or more DEATH GUARD units from your army, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Rejuvenating Swarm
enhancements.legend: With a hacking prayer to Nurgle, this warrior calls upon the swarm. Buzzing clumps of plague‑bearing flies settle upon his bloated form and vomit streams of rejuvenating contagion into festering wounds.

enhancements.formattedDescription: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only. At the end of each phase, the bearer regains all of its lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Plagueveil
enhancements.legend: When this diseased pilgrim marches to sites of festering putrescence, Nurgle’s blessings manifest in a buzzing clot of darkness that falls like an enshrouding fog over them and their disciples.

stratagems.name: DRAWN TO DESPAIR
stratagems.legend: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.

stratagems.legend: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.

stratagems.name: BLIGHTED LAND
stratagems.legend: Firing diseased submunitions or belching swarms of daemonic parasites from its hull, this war engine befouls the battlefield as it advances.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS GRIND
stratagems.legend: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.

stratagems.name: FONT OF FILTH
stratagems.legend: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle's weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.

stratagems.name: EYESTINGER STORM
stratagems.legend: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.

enhancements.name: Bilemaw Blight
enhancements.legend: This foul sorcerer has been blessed with a unique affliction that allows them to inflate their body like a repulsive bellows before vomiting forth a pressurised torrent of filth that would do any Great Unclean One proud.

enhancements.name: Shriekworm Familiar
enhancements.legend: This daemonic familiar lives in the champion’s flesh and watches with bitter paranoia for enemy threats. Should it spot a counterattack from the foe, it bursts forth to scream its shrill warning.

enhancements.name: Tendrilous Emissions
enhancements.legend: This warrior has gained greater control of the vile fumes that billow from their armour, willing them forward like coiling tentacles to wreathe targets and guide in the fire of allied war engines.

stratagems.legend: Gripped by a sudden, monstrous hunger, the Poxwalkers surge forward in a ravenous mass.

stratagems.legend: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.

stratagems.legend: Lacking even basic self-preservation instincts, Poxwalkers make excellent walking shields.

stratagems.legend: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.

abilities.legend: No matter how many Poxwalkers the enemy gun down or tear limb-from-limb at close quarters, more groaning mutants keep coming from every side.

enhancements.legend: This sinister artefact emits a reedy dirge to which Poxwalkers seem drawn and by whose mournful notes they appear energised and lent an echo of purpose.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Walking Pox
enhancements.legend: Gifted by Nurgle to be forever surrounded by shambling packs of Poxwalkers, this champion has become adept at leading their festering hordes into battle.

enhancements.name: Sorrowsyphon
enhancements.legend: Parasitising the miserable scraps of soul within nearby Poxwalkers allows this sorcerer to belch even more malignant clouds of murderous foulness.
enhancements.rawDescription: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. While the bearer is leading a POXWALKERS unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon. enhancements.name: Talisman of Burgeoning
enhancements.legend: This mould-furred talisman is studded with teeth torn from Poxwalkers’ jaws. It bolsters the creatures’ putrid vitality, forcing them to stagger and fight even through grotesque wounds.

stratagems.legend: The daemons of Nurgle grasp their victims tightly with rotting talons and coiling tentacles, their clutch as inescapable as entropy itself.

stratagems.legend: Death Guard warriors open fire into foes already embattled by Nurgle’s daemons, knowing that no matter who they hit, all will wither and rot.

stratagems.legend: Beneath the tread of Nurgle’s daemons, even ferrocrete or plasteel soon turns to a quagmire of rotting matter, in which their unlucky enemies begin to sink and become trapped.

stratagems.legend: Countless diseases blossom in the unreal flesh of Nurgle's daemon childer, manifestations of his blessings to be spread to all.

stratagems.legend: The ephemeral structures of realspace have no power to halt the onset of Nurgle's Great Unclean Ones; they crumble, rot and burst apart before their unholy bulk.

enhancements.name: Fell Harvester
enhancements.legend: This repugnant daemon weapon extrudes swaying tendrils with lamprey maws to strike at the foe.

stratagems.legend: Like fever heat bursting into unclean flame, the diseases infesting these Poxwalkers flare with sudden infectious vitality.

abilities.legend: Like a virus seeking fresh hosts, the unclean worshippers of the Plague God spill through the ship’s corridors on the hunt for untainted souls.

enhancements.name: Pox-Bearer
enhancements.legend: This foul champion is a living vector for the spread of the walking plague, a suppurating nexus of filthy unlife that cannot be cleansed.

enhancements.name: Hand of Nurgle
enhancements.legend: Foul and foetid is the touch of this blessed being, seeping filth and rust-blooming fungi spilling from everything they lay their hands upon.

stratagems.name: DISGUSTINGLY RESILIENT
stratagems.legend: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: PLAGUESURGE
stratagems.legend: The foul miasma around the Death Guard swells and thickens, boiling outward like putrid smog.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Command phase.TARGET: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
stratagems.target: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.

stratagems.name: LEECHSPORE ERUPTION
stratagems.legend: Billowing from this warrior's wounds come clouds of parasitic spores that settle on the foe and drain their vitality, stealing it for the one who spawned them.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Command phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).

stratagems.name: PUTRID DETONATION
stratagems.legend: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Any phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.EFFECT: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

stratagems.name: OVERWHELMING GENEROSITY
stratagems.legend: Unholy filth gushes from Nurgle's faithful into their guns until the armaments threaten to burst like bloated corpses.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.

stratagems.name: CREEPING BLIGHT
stratagems.legend: Those in the grip of Nurgle's unholy plagues become weaker by the moment, barely able to lift their weapons, let alone defend themselves from the attacking Death Guard.
stratagems.fullDescription: WHEN: Your Shooting phase.TARGET: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Worldblight
abilities.legend: As the foul tendrils of the Death Guard quest further across the battlefield, they infest even the most secure, holy and heavily warded sites with supernatural disease. To fight amidst such foulness is a virtual death sentence to the foe, win or lose.
abilities.rawDescription: If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase and a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding Battle-shocked units) is within range of that objective marker, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Nurgle’s Gift ability as if it were a DEATH GUARD model from your army.
abilities.formattedDescription: If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase and a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding Battle-shocked units) is within range of that objective marker, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Nurgle’s Gift ability as if it were a DEATH GUARD model from your army.

enhancements.name: Daemon Weapon of Nurgle
enhancements.legend: Be it the Seeping Blade, the Talon of Befoulment or even the dreaded Axe of Putrescence, this weapon contains a malevolent daemonic entity whose mere touch rots and sickens the foe.
enhancements.rawDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
enhancements.formattedDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Furnace of Plagues
enhancements.legend: This champion’s body blazes with fever as a cornucopia of supernatural diseases churn and roil within. Mere proximity to them is enough to trigger an infectious outbreak of daemonic viruses.
enhancements.rawDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearers melee weapons, and the bearer’s melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
enhancements.formattedDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearers melee weapons, and the bearer’s melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

enhancements.name: Arch Contaminator
enhancements.legend: The unfettered energies of Nurgle’s realm gush from the Warp like foulness from a punctured boil, earthing themselves in the fabric of realspace through this champions repulsive body.
enhancements.rawDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer’s unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
enhancements.formattedDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer’s unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Revolting Regeneration
enhancements.legend: The more wounds blasted and gouged into this champion’s flesh, the more clotted matter, squirming vermin and gangrenous slime spurt forth to coagulate and seal the most grievous hurts.
enhancements.rawDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
enhancements.formattedDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

detachmentAbilities.name: Sevenfold Offerings
detachmentAbilities.legend: Seven by seven the enemy fall, reaped like blighted crops or rotted from within. Seven by seven their souls are offered up to the Lord of Pestilence.
detachmentAbilities.rawDescription: For every seven enemy models that have been destroyed, add 2" to the Contagion Range of units from your army. Note that any increase to the Contagion Range of units from your army as a result of this rule does not take place while a unit from your army is attacking. In such an event, the increase will take effect after such a unit has finished making its attacks.

In such an event, the increase will take effect after such a unit has finished making its attacks.

detachmentAbilities.name: Relentless Spread
detachmentAbilities.legend: Like a virus seeking fresh hosts, the unclean worshippers of the Plague God spill through the ship’s corridors on the hunt for untainted souls.
detachmentAbilities.rawDescription: Each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army makes a Consolidation move:It can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".If it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units that are visible to it (and in Unit Coherency), it can still make that Consolidation move, and when doing so can move in any direction.
detachmentAbilities.formattedDescription: Each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army makes a Consolidation move:It can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".If it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units that are visible to it (and in Unit Coherency), it can still make that Consolidation move, and when doing so can move in any direction.

detachmentAbilities.name: Inescapable Corruption
detachmentAbilities.legend: The combined plague blessings of so many champions of the Plague God is universally contagious, a dreadful omnirot that infests flesh, metal and even the minds and souls of its victims.
detachmentAbilities.rawDescription: Each time an enemy unit is selected to perform a Tactical Manoeuvre, if that unit is within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that Tactical Manoeuvre has no effect (that enemy unit is still eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn as normal).In addition, in your Command phase, roll one D6 for each objective marker that is within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army and is Secured by your opponent’s army: on a 5+, that objective marker is no longer Secured by your opponent’s army.

detachmentAbilities.name: Verminous Haze
detachmentAbilities.legend: A cloud of winged insects descends over Mortarion’s pathogenic sons, obscuring their malodorous ranks and shielding them from the eyes and augurs of the enemy. Beneath thrumming storms of fat-bodied flies, Plague Marines stride towards their wavering foes until they are close enough to unleash punishing volleys of killing fire.

detachmentAbilities.name: Miasmic Bombardment
detachmentAbilities.legend: In the wake of preparatory bombardment by artillery weapons both forbidden and foul, the surviving foe are left reeling amidst clouds of plague smog. With their flesh running like tallow and their weapons rusting in their hands, they will be hard-pressed to fight back.

detachmentAbilities.name: Manifold Maladies
detachmentAbilities.legend: A spirit of competition infects Nurgle’s champions when they fight alongside one another. With each vying to outdo the others in virulence, the foes are subjected to a riotous string of nightmarish outbreaks amongst their ranks.
detachmentAbilities.rawDescription: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle’s Gift. Until the end of the battle, that is your chosen Plague instead of any previously chosen Plague.

detachmentAbilities.name: Reverberant Rancidity
detachmentAbilities.legend: Reality rings like a struck bell as it rebels against the sheer wrongness of Nurgle’s daemons. Borne upon these jarring waves of metaphysical disease, magnified and redoubled with every dolorous peal, the Plague God’s myriad infections spread and multiply all the faster.

detachmentAbilities.name: Numberless Horde
detachmentAbilities.legend: No matter how many Poxwalkers the enemy gun down or tear limb-from-limb at close quarters, more groaning mutants keep coming from every side.

detachmentAbilities.name: Deadly Vectors
detachmentAbilities.legend: The plagues and parasites to which these elite warriors play host are amongst the most lethal in the galaxy. Moment by moment, even the most resilient foes sicken and wither in their presence until all that remains is rotted matter deliquescing sloppily from mouldering bones.
detachmentAbilities.rawDescription: In your opponent’s Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit, subtracting 1 from the result if that unit is Below Half-strength. If the result is 6 or less, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
detachmentAbilities.formattedDescription: In your opponent’s Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit, subtracting 1 from the result if that unit is Below Half-strength. If the result is 6 or less, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Miasmic Odour
enhancements.legend: An omnipresent reek of decay wreathes this dark champion, mingling with swarms of parasitic plague flies and turgid clouds of infectious spores.
enhancements.rawDescription: Add 3" to the Contagion Range of the bearer.
enhancements.formattedDescription: Add 3" to the Contagion Range of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Final Ingredient
enhancements.legend: Be it the eye of a Kroot or a Space Marine’s hearts, ground Ork tusk, or something unnameable wrenched from within a Tyranid’s corpse, this champion needs just one more ingredient to perfect a powerful new plague.
enhancements.rawDescription: BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER only. Once per battle, after the bearers unit has fought, if one or more CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.

enhancements.name: Droning Chorus
enhancements.legend: Festering swarms follow this champion to battle, and the drone of a billion flies invigorates his warriors’ rotting bodies, lending them fresh focus.
enhancements.rawDescription: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
enhancements.formattedDescription: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

enhancements.name: Witherbone Pipes
enhancements.legend: This sinister artefact emits a reedy dirge to which Poxwalkers seem drawn and by whose mournful notes they appear energised and lent an echo of purpose.
enhancements.rawDescription: NOXIOUS BLIGHTBRINGER only. While the bearer is leading a POXWALKERS unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.
enhancements.formattedDescription: NOXIOUS BLIGHTBRINGER only. While the bearer is leading a POXWALKERS unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.

enhancements.name: Pox-Bearer
enhancements.legend: This foul champion is a living vector for the spread of the walking plague, a suppurating nexus of filthy unlife that cannot be cleansed.
enhancements.rawDescription: Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly POXWALKERS unit within 9" of and visible to the bearer; return up to D3+2 destroyed models to that unit.

enhancements.name: Foul Constitution
enhancements.legend: Rancid with might, feverish with unclean power, this warrior’s diseased body is as unnaturally resilient as it is unfeeling of pain.

enhancements.formattedDescription: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: Eye of Affliction
enhancements.legend: Peering at the world through this bloated yellow orb, the bearer of this vile gift sees the souls of the sickened burning bright as targeting flares no matter how their victims try to hide.
enhancements.rawDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ignores cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.
enhancements.formattedDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ignores cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Face of Death
enhancements.legend: So grotesque and monstrous is this champion’s aspect that it fills the enemy with unreasoning dread simply to look upon him.
enhancements.rawDescription: TERMINATOR model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.
enhancements.formattedDescription: TERMINATOR model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Beckoning Blight
enhancements.legend: This unclean gift infects its host with animaluminescent fungus. Once their spirit is riddled with incorporeal mycelia, it begins to glow. This sickly radiance acts like a guiding lantern to the daemons of Nurgle, who follow its glare into realspace.
enhancements.rawDescription: DEATH GUARD model only. Each time a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models, instead of more than 9".
